name: Departure Board
description: A station board on split flaps whose top train departs on a timer while the rows below move up, with delays in camellia and a flap clock.

props.name: departures
props.type: { time: string; destination: string; train: string; track: string | number; delay?: number }[]
props.description: The timetable in order. Times are "HH:MM" and delay is in minutes. It may be longer than the board: when the top train departs every row takes the next one's place and the next departure enters at the bottom, and the list loops when it runs out. A delay shows as "+6 MIN" in camellia.

props.name: station
props.description: Station name in the header, also used for the accessible name and the table caption.

props.name: caption
props.description: Muted line under the station name, such as the board's name and the date.

props.name: time
props.description: Starting station time as "HH:MM". The clock then runs as a time lapse: it steps minute by minute toward the top train's departure (plus its delay) and the train leaves when the clock reaches it. Without it the clock shows the device's local time, read after mounting and updated each minute.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card. Below 520px wide the train column is dropped and the status becomes a short delay column ("+6", blank when on time) so the flaps stay legible. Other section props are passed through.
